definition.label: Report to the supervisor in the workroom and read the terms
Accept the supervisor's allocated Seer dose (no faculty yet; one pathway per life, switching is a stated cause of loss of control)

effects.value: One prepared dose now sits in your hands under the supervisor's allocation. Taking it into your body is a separate, irreversible step: you can still decline, and holding it grants nothing. Disturbed senses and trouble focusing follow ingestion; guided attention on a familiar object eases them. Supervision is not a guarantee for every recipient.

definition.label: Decline the dose and keep your ordinary clerical work

effects.value: You declined. Nothing was spent and no faculty was granted; your post and the supervisor's goodwill are unchanged. The offer stands only while the supervisor still holds the dose.

definition.label: Take the dose under supervision (irreversible, one short guided attention)

effects.value: The dose is gone for good. Senses flared, whispers pressed in, and holding your attention on a familiar object under the supervisor's guidance brought them down. You hold a Seer source but no method: control is taught, not given. This reading shows what happened to one supervised body, not that every novice is safe.

definition.label: Take the control lesson: learn bounded material perception · 1 spirituality, 5 min

effects.value: You can now deliberately look at one material in front of you and end the sight. It costs spirituality and tires you; it shows presence at the material, not identity, safety or future. Ending the sight stops new cost; it does not undo fatigue.

definition.label: Take the ordinary comparator from the supervisor's bench
Observe the ordinary comparator · 1 spirituality, 1 min

effects.value: Through the learned channel this ordinary comparator showed no signal. A negative reading here is a limited observation: it is not proof the material is safe, unpoisoned or unwatched.

definition.label: Return the comparator with your finding

effects.value: The probationer returned the sample with a limited finding. I hold the material again and the attributed note; it does not certify safety.

definition.label: Take the supported sample lot A from the supervisor's bench
Observe the sample lot A · 1 spirituality, 1 min

effects.value: Through the learned channel this lot showed a signal at the material. You can say that it is present and where it sits, not what it is made of, whether it is safe, or who prepared it.

definition.label: Return the sample lot A with your finding

effects.value: The probationer returned the sample with a limited finding. I hold the material again and the attributed note; it does not certify safety.

definition.label: Take the supported sample lot B from the supervisor's bench
Observe the sample lot B · 1 spirituality, 1 min

effects.value: Through the learned channel this second lot showed a different signal at the material. As before, the reading is limited: no identity, recipe or safety follows from it.

definition.label: Return the sample lot B with your finding

effects.value: The probationer returned the sample with a limited finding. I hold the material again and the attributed note; it does not certify safety.

definition.label: Answer a client from the request ledger with a hedged reading · 1 spirituality, 10 min

effects.value: You read for a client and kept it vague: a hint, never a promise. Staying inside the Seer's role, curious about fate but wary of it, settles something in you a little more each time.

definition.label: Refuse a ledger request to divine someone far above your station

effects.value: You turned down the request to look at a powerful person. Fearing what fate might show is also part of the role, and that restraint counted.

definition.label: Ask Warden Hale to assess your digestion for the next Sequence

effects.value: Hale tested you and judged the Seer potion digested. The workroom releases one prepared Clown dose from its stores. Holding it grants nothing; drinking it is another irreversible step.

definition.label: Drink the prepared Clown dose (irreversible: Sequence 8)

effects.value: The Clown potion is gone for good. The same whispers rose and passed. Your body answers faster and steadier, and your face holds whatever you set on it. This Sequence needs digesting in turn, by its own role.

definition.label: Accept the supervisor's allocated Corpse Collector dose (no faculty yet; one pathway per life, switching is a stated cause of loss of control)

effects.value: One prepared dose now sits in your hands under the supervisor's allocation, and Hale keeps the Seer dose back: a second pathway's potion is switching and would risk loss of control. The formula includes a dried black-spotted frog and the dose takes courage to drink. Holding it grants nothing; you can still decline.

definition.label: Take the Corpse Collector dose under supervision (irreversible)

effects.value: The dose is gone for good. The cold came first, then a stillness; the unclaimed dead in the cold room stopped feeling like a threat. Your skin is paler. You hold a Corpse Collector source and a body that shrugs off cold and rot. Hale says the potion is digested by quiet, repeated work among the dead, not by waiting.

definition.label: Wash and shroud an unclaimed body in the cold room with Hale watching · 1 of Hale's attention, 25 min

effects.value: You laid out an unclaimed body without flinching and without hurry. Handling the dead plainly, as a collector would, settles something in you a little more each time.

definition.label: Keep the night vigil beside the cold room's dead · 1 of Hale's attention, 60 min

effects.value: You sat an hour in the cold with the dead and did not leave. Staying calm among them, even when they seemed to notice you, was part of the role and it counted.

definition.label: Ask Warden Hale to assess your digestion for the next Sequence (Corpse Collector)

effects.value: Hale tested you and judged the Corpse Collector potion digested. The workroom releases one prepared Gravedigger dose from its stores. Holding it grants nothing; drinking it is another irreversible step.

definition.label: Drink the prepared Gravedigger dose (irreversible: Sequence 8)

effects.value: The Gravedigger potion is gone for good. Your body is stronger and quicker, and the quiet in the cold room now has voices in it, faint and near. This Sequence needs digesting in turn, by its own role.

definition.label: Accept the records officer's allocated Savant dose (no faculty yet; one pathway per life, switching is a stated cause of loss of control)

effects.value: One prepared dose now sits in your hands under the records officer's allocation. The Machinery team keeps its line to its own probationers: you are not offered another church's potion. Holding it grants nothing; you can still decline.

definition.label: Take the Savant dose under supervision (irreversible)

effects.value: The dose is gone for good. Facts rose faster than you could name them, then settled into order. You hold a Savant source. The officer says the potion is digested by living as a Savant, studying and applying, and that the church will not examine you for years whatever you recall.

definition.label: Study the team's repair ledgers and record what the gears show · 1 of the records officer's attention, 30 min

effects.value: You studied until you could say how each mechanism failed and why. Treating what you know as something to apply, not to hoard, settles something in you a little more each time.

definition.label: Apply what you studied: price a replacement part from the ledger · 1 of the records officer's attention, 45 min

effects.value: You turned the ledger into a number someone paid. Applying knowledge, the Savant's other half, counted.

definition.label: Ask the records officer to pre-screen your digestion before the senior deacon

effects.value: The records officer tested your recall and judged the potion digested. That is only the local pre-screen: the senior deacon examines, and the church waits out its term first.

definition.label: Sit the senior deacon's examination · 60 min, 1 of the deacon's attention

effects.value: The senior deacon examined you, found the potion digested and understood, and released one prepared Archaeologist dose from the church's stores. Holding it grants nothing; drinking it is another irreversible step.

definition.label: Drink the prepared Archaeologist dose (irreversible: Sequence 8)

effects.value: The Archaeologist potion is gone for good. Your body is stronger and old facts about ruins and survival come to you unasked. This Sequence needs digesting in turn, by its own role.

definition.label: Accept the duty officer's allocated Sailor dose (no faculty yet; one pathway per life, switching is a stated cause of loss of control)

effects.value: One prepared dose now sits in your hands under the duty officer's allocation. The Mandated Punishers keep this line to their own probationers. Holding it grants nothing; you can still decline.

definition.label: Take the Sailor dose under supervision (irreversible)

effects.value: The dose is gone for good. The sea rolled through you and your balance held; your skin prickled where scales might sit. You hold a Sailor source. The officer says it is digested by repeating the sea's discipline, not by waiting.

definition.label: Lash a sealed crate against the harbour swell · 1 of the duty officer's attention, 20 min

effects.value: You lashed the crate while the quay moved under you and kept your feet. Staying steady on a moving deck, as a sailor does, settles something in you a little more each time.

definition.label: Hold your breath under the quay for the dive drill · 1 of the duty officer's attention, 30 min

effects.value: You went under the quay and stayed until the officer signalled. Calm in deep water, as a sailor is, counted.

definition.label: Ask the duty officer to pre-screen your digestion before the senior deacon

effects.value: The duty officer judged the Sailor potion digested. That is only the local pre-screen: the Storm senior deacon examines, and the church waits out its term first.

definition.label: Sit the Storm senior deacon's examination · 60 min, 1 of the deacon's attention

effects.value: The Storm senior deacon examined you, found the potion digested, and released one prepared Folk of Rage dose from the church's stores. Holding it grants nothing; drinking it is another irreversible step.

definition.label: Drink the prepared Folk of Rage dose (irreversible: Sequence 8)

effects.value: The Folk of Rage potion is gone for good. Anger now arrives with speed and strength attached, and it takes longer to cool. This Sequence needs digesting in turn, by its own role.

definition.label: Buy the Corpse Collector formula on Hale's terms · 5 pounds (a scaled proposal; the canon price is 230)

effects.value: Hale wrote the Sequence 9 formula out for you and took the fee. A dried black-spotted frog is the main material. He reminds you a potion is brewed under his eye at this bench, takes time to settle, and that this is a second way to the same dose: a brewed dose replaces the issued one.

definition.label: Start brewing the Corpse Collector potion at Hale's bench: consumes a dried black-spotted frog and 1 of Hale's attention

effects.value: The frog is in the pot and Hale has set the bench. It needs 120 minutes before it can be bottled. You cannot take another pathway's dose while it stands.

definition.label: Bottle the brewed Corpse Collector dose

effects.value: The pot settled and you bottled one dose, the same potion the workroom issues. Holding it grants nothing; drinking it is the separate, irreversible step, and it takes the place of an allocation.
